g.text: Accepted candidate events: descriptive VGNC associations
Each accepted event once. Lines = observed minimum to maximum; dots = median. These are not confidence intervals.
Cohorts refer only to changed scored pairs: TP-only, FP-only, mixed, or unlabeled. Unlabeled does not mean correct or true negative.
Transitive pairs have no assigned direct event. Accepted-event group support does not establish a direct protein-pair HMM hit.
Development-exposed; membership, group size and reference scope confound differences. No threshold, confidence or causal inference.
